primary_record.hypotheses: Nc>=3, fundamental quarks, chirally broken phase, leading finite-volume chiral theory, no QED, 1/Lambda << L << 1/Mpi, flat Euclidean torus in the source; heavy non-Goldstone modes omitted/factorized.
primary_record.normalization_translation: We choose integral_SU2 dU=1, so Ztilde=2 I1(z)/z and Ztilde(0)=1. Source equations (24),(50) use I1(z)/z, differing by a mass/theta/volume-independent factor 1/2. The mass- and theta-derivatives agree. Our fixed-nu coefficients consistently sum to our Haar-normalized expression. We do not infer an absolute gravitational normalization from either convention.
primary_record.condensate_translation: Our positive per-flavor magnitude is C=(1/(2V)) d_m logZ for a common degenerate mass. Source (12) includes an additional 1/Nf in each individual-mass derivative; the source's sum (13), in the degenerate case, equals our C. Condensate sign conventions are explicitly avoided by defining the derivative.
